description.p: Kamerton tunes guitars, basses, ukuleles, mandolins, banjos and the violin family by listening through the microphone, or plays reference tones when a microphone is not available.

ul.li: An analog VU meter with an “In tune” lamp, a strobe and an LED bar display
A Les Paul style headstock whose tuner keys show each string’s note and frequency
Automatic string detection, or click a string to play its reference tone
Works in a small window next to your DAW: the full panels open in floating windows
Input level meter with a noise gate you can drag while tuning, or set from the noise of the room
VU meter, strobe and LED bar displays
Les Paul style headstock with chrome tuner keys
Automatic string detection and reference tones
Noise gate you can drag on the input level meter
A compact layout for small windows, with floating full panels
